description.value: The Farmhouse On Main is a mother-daughter-owned café, gift shop, and artisan marketplace in downtown Fort St. John, serving handcrafted soups, sandwiches, baked goods, and specialty coffee from BC roasters. It grew from a local food-box distribution hub and artisan marketplace into what the owners call the town's largest gift shop and top lunch spot, featuring an olive oil bar, Canadian and local brands, home décor, and a rotating cast of local artisan vendors. Cyclists passing through Fort St. John will find a full sit-down café experience with a strong community-made character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (10044 100 Street, Fort St. John, BC V1J 3Y4) and phone number (250-262-1485). The business is clearly active — blog posts run through mid-2024, and the site describes an expanded café offering soups, sandwiches, baked goods, and BC-roasted coffee. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null; the OSM internet_access tag is not confirmed by the website and is therefore not treated as authoritative.
concerns: OSM name 'Farmhouse on Main & Coffee Bar' differs slightly from the website's consistent branding 'The Farmhouse On Main & coffee bar' / 'The Farmhouse On Main' — missing leading 'The' and capitalization differs.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active café and gift shop with a verified address, phone, and current website; a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Fort St. John.

wow_evidence: mother-daughter-owned café, gift shop, and artisan marketplace in downtown Fort St. John
